title: The Little Blue Haus - Two Miles to Broadway
description:
Complimentary 🍷. Located just 2 miles from Downtown Nashville this total renovated house, beautifully designed home with a large private backyard comfortably sleeps 6 guests, features all high-end appliances, furnishings, tech, and entertainment! Just minutes away from everything Nashville has to offer our expertly decorated and furnished home is designed to provide you with the best  Nashville experience. Backyard has outdoor fire pit, covered patio and perfect for outdoor entertainment.

The space
This 100% private, clean,  Traditional cottage offers quick & convenient access to all the city's best dining, tourist stops, nightlife, and conventions. This home is perfect for visitors coming to enjoy a football/soccer/baseball/hockey game, bachelorette/family weekend or business traveler wanting to be in the city. This home has 3 cozy bedrooms furnished with modern furniture throughout the house and private outside entertainment area. Bedrooms have King and full beds equipped with a smart home device that controls lights along with smart Tv's, and Xfinity TV. Full kitchen W/ coffee + snack bar and air fryer.

Guest access
You'll have access to the entire property.

Other things to note
Guest will receive a complimentary wine 🍷 for booking a stay at the Little Blue House.
